tool_limitations.limitation: Only greps 'unsupported' + 'residueOnly' inventory patterns, NOT 'adaptable' ones, so a reverted-to-UWP ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotifier() call passes residue grep clean.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: N/A here (runtime-only, path unreachable at startup); handled via prose guidance instead.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only proves the process stayed alive 10s after launch; the toast code path fires on a later button click that is Denied on a dev box, so a latent notification bug never executes and never fails the gate.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Prose guidance so the agent migrates notifications correctly the first time rather than relying on a runtime gate that cannot reach the path.

failed_apis.why_tried: Correct WinAppSDK replacement for UWP ToastNotificationManager, applied per TODO[migrate-001] -> PATTERNS.md#notifications
failed_apis.root_cause: Register() was called in the App constructor but the app's Package.appxmanifest declared no windows.toastNotificationActivation / windows.comServer COM activator extension, so activation-server registration failed and crashed startup with native stowed exception 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll.
failed_apis.fix: Correct fix is to declare the toast activator COM extension in the manifest and Register()/Unregister() around app lifetime. The agent instead REVERTED to the UWP ToastNotificationManager (see doc_errors).

doc_errors.wrong: Bare 2-row mapping table + doc link. It says ToastNotificationManager -> AppNotificationManager but gives no registration lifecycle, no manifest activator requirement, and no warning that a naive AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() crashes at startup. This under-specification led the agent to migrate, crash, misattribute, and revert to the UWP API.
doc_errors.correct: Must state: (1) call AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() at startup + Unregister() at exit; (2) packaged apps must declare the windows.toastNotificationActivation + windows.comServer extensions in the manifest; (3) do NOT fall back to Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager - its parameterless CreateToastNotifier() throws at runtime in unpackaged WinUI 3 desktop apps.

doc_errors.wrong: Generic guidance 'legacy projection/activation incompatibility ... if unsupported on the current OS, defer it' nudged the agent to remove/defer the API rather than fix its registration.
doc_errors.correct: Add the specific cause: 0xC000027B right after adding AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() means the toast activator COM extension is missing from the manifest - fix the manifest, do not revert to the UWP API.

special_apis.special_handling: WinRT API is used as-is in WinUI 3 desktop; compiles and returns Denied at runtime on a desktop dev box (expected). No bespoke handling needed - migrated cleanly.

Parameterless CreateToastNotifier() requires an AppUserModelId / package identity; it only worked here because the final app was packaged. In an unpackaged WinUI 3 desktop app it throws. Correct target is Microsoft.Windows.AppNotifications.AppNotificationManager.

errors_encountered.error: Startup crash 0xc000027b (native stowed exception) in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll, Test-AppLaunch FAIL
errors_encountered.root_cause: AppNotificationManager.Default.Register() called with no windows.toastNotificationActivation/comServer extension declared in Package.appxmanifest.
errors_encountered.fix: Agent removed Register() and reverted the toast to UWP ToastNotificationManager (works only because app is packaged); the correct fix is to declare the manifest activator and keep the WinAppSDK API.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Migrated toast to AppNotificationManager, app crashed at startup 0xc000027b; ~3 turns of crash triage (Test-AppLaunch, event-log inspection) then removed Register() and reverted the whole toast to the UWP ToastNotificationManager.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill's notifications guidance omitted the mandatory Register/Unregister lifecycle and the manifest COM activator extension, so the agent could not connect the crash to the missing registration and gave up on the correct API.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Reverted to UWP ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotifier() - green build + alive smoke launch, but a latent runtime defect for unpackaged targets.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Strengthening MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#notifications with the registration lifecycle + manifest activator requirement + an explicit 'do not revert to ToastNotificationManager' warning, and a startup-crashes cross-reference for 0xC000027B after Register().

env_issues.issue: ExtendedExecutionSession.RequestExtensionAsync() returns Denied on a headless desktop dev box; toast (allowed) path never executes.
env_issues.workaround: Behavioral parity was scored on the Denied path, which matches UWP behavior on the same host; the latent toast bug never ran.
